possible_outcomes: PASS_EXISTING_ROOTS — original cohort manifests recovered and five-way independence proven
PASS_DETERMINISTIC_ALLOCATION — sealed deterministic C/P allocation and five-way independence proven
HOLD_INPUTS_MISSING or HOLD_MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE — required evidence absent or malformed; no retraining conclusion

B_identity_root_recovery_and_preregistra.gate_to_phase_c: cp_inference_authorized=true from the authoritative Phase B V3.1 validator; this authorizes C/P Student inference only

steps: 1. Generate and seal authoritative external-R7 K10 Teacher bundles for exact C, P, and H identities; exclude A and reserved pools
2. Run the authoritative Phase B V3.1 validator with full allocation, Teacher-contract, source-step, identity, K10, and bundle-seal bindings
3. Only if cp_inference_authorized=true, run checkpoint inference on C identities into a new sealed calibration-prediction root
4. Run checkpoint inference on P identities into a physically separate sealed policy-selection-prediction root
5. Bind every prediction to checkpoint SHA, source commit, feature-order SHA, normalization SHA, source episode SHA, and identity-role manifest SHA
6. Fit the pre-registered calibration candidates on C predictions; freeze the selected calibrator without reading H or A
7. Replay the real runtime adapter on P predictions; jointly select and freeze grasp/manipulation/release thresholds without reading H or A
8. Verify independent calibrator-freeze and scheduler-freeze receipts and emit the external heldout-L3 authorization receipt
9. Only then run heldout-L3 Student inference exactly once on H identities and evaluate the frozen pipeline
10. Require 12/12 closure, worst-split negative false-start ≤ 0.10, non-zero valid-opportunity recall, per-suite trigger coverage, and no identity/provenance leakage
11. Keep attack-eval A unread and unmaterialized until the detector freeze, runtime parity, and canary preregistration gates pass

fields.candidate_close: Runtime-causal. Source: Codex action contract. NOT teacher event_id.
fields.action_known: Runtime-causal. Whether action intent is reliably classified.
fields.student_valid: Runtime-causal. Source: Codex. NOT route_supported proxy.
fields.route_supported: Whether mechanism route is in supported set.
fields.release_probability: sigmoid(release_logit). Conservative veto candidate. Not pure-release equivalent.

calibration.purpose: fit calibrators, compute head discrimination/calibration metrics
calibration.forbidden: must not affect scheduler state transitions

evaluation.purpose: audit-only — judge whether scheduler emit is correct
evaluation.forbidden: must not affect scheduler state transitions

k10_opportunity.description: strict_k10_feasible[t] already means a complete T10 window exists starting at t.
k10_opportunity.positive_episode: at least one VALID_START in the eligible domain
k10_opportunity.negative_episode: ALL positions in the eligible domain are known AND strict_k10_feasible=false for ALL
k10_opportunity.unknown_episode: eligible domain has any unknown position, AND no known positive exists
k10_opportunity.eligible_domain: steps 0 to T-10 (positions that can host a complete T10 window), per Teacher contract
k10_opportunity.no_double_horizon: Do NOT require consecutive feasible-start blocks of min_length=8. Do NOT require emit_step+9 within a feasible-start block.
k10_opportunity.containment: emit_step is a VALID_START — containment is inherent in the strict_k10_feasible definition
k10_opportunity.insufficient_coverage: If Teacher bundle lacks complete eligible-domain known info, classify as BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_K10_KNOWN_COVERAGE
